# Classical Decor ID (DST Deco) — Dubai Architectural Surfaces & Interior Finishes

> Classical Decor ID (DST Deco) is Dubai's premier B2B supplier of luxury interior and exterior architectural surfaces, catering to interior designers, architects, fit-out contractors, and villa developers across the United Arab Emirates.

- **Brand Name**: Classical Decor ID

## Core Material Collections & Technical Capabilities
- **SPC Rigid Core Flooring**: 100% waterproof, anti-termite, high-density stone plastic composite flooring with integrated IXPE acoustic underlayment and UV ceramic wear layer. Suitable for coastal villas, hotels, and commercial spaces.
- **Flexible Stone Veneer**: Ultra-thin natural metamorphic stone veneers reinforced with fiberglass backing. Engineered for curved columns, feature walls, and interior/exterior facades.
- **Big PU Stone & Rock Wall Panels**: High-density polyurethane architectural wall cladding with realistic stone textures (travertine, feather stone, volcanic rock) weighing only 3–4 kg/m² for rapid, adhesive-based installation.
- **WPC Fluted Louvers & Exterior Cladding**: Wood-plastic composite fluted panels and exterior facade slats resistant to UV, fading, rot, and moisture. Rated Class B1 fire retardant.
- **Acoustic Slat Louvers**: Premium polyester acoustic felt backing laminated with natural wood veneer slats for architectural sound dampening and visual warmth.
- **Architectural Trims & Installation Hardware**: Complete inventory of anodized aluminum edge trims, stair nosing, skirting profiles, structural bonding silicon, and expansion joints.

## Commercial Specifications & Trade Terms
- **UAE Dispatch Timelines**: 24–48 hours across Dubai, Sharjah, and Ajman for in-stock materials; 2–3 business days for Abu Dhabi, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, and Umm Al Quwain.
- **Complimentary Architectural Sample Boxes**: Curated VIP sample boxes containing genuine cut finishes and technical datasheets dispatched free of charge to architects and contractors.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Zero rigid MOQ on local warehouse inventory; tiered container-level wholesale pricing available for high-volume commercial projects.
- **Certifications & Compliance**: Class B1 fire retardant standard, 100% waterproof certification, formaldehyde-free eco-friendly composition compliant with UAE interior architectural requirements.
